games.name: REALMS RPG
games.description:
Your main character arc starts with a Copper Sword.

⚔️ Bonk enemies, chain combos, parry attacks and dash out of boss slams.
🌍 Explore 16 realms, plus the village hub.
🛠️ Collect 54 swords and 54 armor sets through gold, boss drops and optional gamepasses.
👑 Challenge 13 bosses and bring friends for the final showdown.
✨ Build your Aura, equip cosmetic trails and unlock titles.
🎁 Claim free daily gifts, complete contracts and finish your Journey.

PC: hold click to attack • F to block/parry • Q to dash
Mobile: equip a weapon and use the touch controls.

Optional cosmetics, equipment gamepasses and timed boosts are available in the shop.

games.name: Go Up!
games.description:
🎈 GO UP!

The higher you fly, the more coins you earn — but watch out! Other players can use their dart guns to POP your balloon and send you falling.

🎈 Inflate & Fly — Blow up your balloon and soar as high as possible!
💰 Earn Coins — Reach greater heights and pop other players for rewards!
🔫 Pop Players — Upgrade your dart gun and shoot balloons out of the sky!
⬆️ Upgrade — Get bigger, faster balloons and stronger dart guns!
☁️ Discover New Worlds — Fly through Cloud World, Candyland, Heaven, Valhalla, and beyond!
🛡️ Stay Protected — Get a temporary shield after your balloon gets popped!

How high can you go? 🎈☁️🏰

games.name: Break Everything
games.description:
BREAK EVERYTHING

Smash block-built worlds, earn cash, and turn your starter hammer into a destruction machine.

💥 Upgrade through 46 tools, from chainsaws and rocket launchers to black holes, Thor’s Hammer, and the Antimatter Siege Cannon.
🌍 Explore 15 realms, from desert pyramids, Atlantis, and the Moon to giant toys, a clockwork carnival, and Dreamweaver Workshop.
👟 Buy faster shoes to race through the realms.
🔁 Rebirth for permanent damage, cash, and block-breaking bonuses—and unlock later realms.
🏆 Join two-minute demolition events where everyone gets the same randomly rolled weapon. Break the most blocks, earn cash and trophies, and unlock titles.

How much can you break?

games.name: [🎃] Build the Eiffel Tower!
games.description:
🗼 Welcome to Build the Eiffel Tower!

Build Paris’s most iconic landmark together, one block at a time.

How to Play:
🧱 Collect blocks and carry them to the tower.
🤝 Work with the whole server to raise its voxel lattice legs, observation decks, and summit.
⚡ Train Speed and Strength, upgrade your French hero, and unlock Paris companions.
🏆 Complete towers, enjoy the celebration orbit, and relax in the terrace hot tubs for bonus training.
🎃 Travel to Haunted Paris to build a spooky Eiffel Tower and earn Lanterns!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players.
